scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build -w @telpen/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:domain && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @telpen/api" "npm run dev -w @telpen/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @telpen/domain && npm run typecheck -w @telpen/api && npm run typecheck -w @telpen/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @telpen/domain && npm run test -w @telpen/api
scripts.deploy:railway:web: railway deployment up --service web --environment production --detach --yes --message "Deploy web from local workspace"
scripts.deploy:railway:api: railway deployment up --service api --environment production --detach --yes --message "Deploy API from local workspace"
scripts.deploy:railway: npm run deploy:railway:web && npm run deploy:railway:api
